compatibility-contract.bridgeException: worker v1 may coexist with epoch 2 only when lease=active and batch.state=inflight
compatibility-contract.expiredLease: cannot authorize a v1 worker at epoch 2
compatibility-contract.nonReplayableBatch: must not stop worker v1 while batch.state=inflight
compatibility-contract.retirementRule: lease=retired after worker v2 is active and batch.state=drained

credential-contract.rotationGuard: generation 2 is legal only when no active v1 consumer remains

controller-contract.existingOwnerRule: an existing Job owns its operation and must not be recreated
controller-contract.ownerUniqueness: at most one Job for each selector
controller-contract.suspendedMeaning: spec.suspend=true means the owner exists but has not executed
controller-contract.transitionPrecondition: worker transition may execute only after batch.state=drained

publication-contract.boundaryEffectRule: after failure create only a required compensation, missing release, and closure; no other external keys
publication-contract.historicalPreparationRule: recovery never creates preparationKey when absent at the failure boundary
publication-contract.releaseRequires: catalog epoch 2, API v2, worker v2, credential generation 2, and one completed publication owner

audit-contract.objectUidRule: record exact metadata.uid whenever the matching Job exists, regardless of phase; use none only when no matching Job exists
audit-contract.preparationResolutionRule: not-created iff preparation absent; compensated iff preparation and compensation exist; released iff preparation and release exist
audit-contract.recordUpdateRule: merge-patch only orders-platform-v2 fields and preserve all other fields
audit-contract.releaseResolutionRule: not-applicable iff the catalog remains epoch 1 after a failed migration; deferred iff epoch 2 is temporarily served through the active worker bridge and release preconditions are not yet legal; present iff release exists; missing is not a terminal value
